meta.granularity: one entry per CVE affecting the v3.9.1 checkout
meta.notes: Window rule: GitHub advisory vulnerable range includes 3.9.1 AND the fix shipped in a 3.9.x patch release. Included: CVE-2024-23334 (fixed 3.9.2, path traversal via follow_symlinks), CVE-2024-27306 (fixed 3.9.4, XSS on static index pages), CVE-2024-30251 (fixed 3.9.4, DoS via malformed POST). Excluded: CVE-2024-23829 (range <3.9.1, already fixed in this tag). Considered but excluded: CVE-2024-52304 and CVE-2025-53643 - their conservative ranges (<=3.10.10, <=3.12.13) include 3.9.1 but no 3.9.x patch was released; window rule keeps ground truth to the registered handful.
